rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AB label and notes expanded blastocyst, ICM, and looser TE, but it overstates visibility of specific features in this low-clarity image and likely infers thinning zona/TE details more from the Gardner score than from the image itself.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, semen quality, BMI, endometrium, and prior failed cycle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a plausible prognosis estimate tied to case factors, though some quantitative adjustments are somewhat heuristic and a few image-based claims are more confident than warranted.

Mostly aligned on SET and general prognosis, but recommendations such as routine assisted hatching, EmbryoGlue, ERA/chronic endometritis/thrombophilia workup after limited failure, and PGT-A consideration in a 25-year-old are more aggressive than standard guideline-based practice.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer technique, luteal support, lifestyle, and contingency planning, though some suggested add-ons and investigations may not be appropriately selective for this low-risk patient.
